zweig: Zweig means the same as Stefan Zweig.
zwieback: Zwieback is slice of sweet raised bread baked again until it is brown and hard and crisp.
Zwieback means the same as rusk or Brussels biscuit or twice-baked bread.
zwingli: Zwingli is Swiss theologian whose sermons began the Reformation in Switzerland.
Zwingli means the same as Ulrich Zwingli or Huldreich Zwingli.
zworykin: Zworykin is United States physicist who invented the iconoscope.
Zworykin means the same as Vladimir Kosma Zworykin.
